title: Resolve missing known-new project capacity authority

conditions.description: Identify and pin an authoritative producer/contract for known-new project creation and complete writer coverage, project total/role policy, inventory/generation, reservation and uncertain-effect occupancy, and trustworthy observation time, all composable in the same project Git CAS. Or reconcile the task's scope with a HOLD-only result. Accepted abef95dc's initializer is test-only; fixture records cannot prove production baseline or writer coverage. Existing LedgerHeader only supplies project/ledger/epoch and per-agent MaxWorkingPerAgent; scripts/jarvis-phase2-snapshot-adapter.mjs intentionally marks project capacity incomplete. Please specify the owner/source and exact contract; no extra approval/signature system.
